_comment: Bake-off candidates (2026-09-30), cheapest-first by owner request: spend as little as possible. Prices are read from OpenRouter's public /api/v1/models at report time. Every OpenRouter request carries provider.data_collection=deny (owner: never a provider that may train on or store our data); run.py --preflight drops a model with no compliant endpoint. No frontier model by default: the reference answers are Claude's own past work. Rubric tasks are judged blind by Claude (no paid judges); judge.py uses OpenRouter judges only if 'judges' is filled in.
